title: [Prime] Roborock Qrevo Edge Robot Vacuum and Mop $799 (after $100 Coupon) Delivered @ Roborock via Amazon AU
body:
Deal: [Prime] Roborock Qrevo Edge Robot Vacuum and Mop $799 (after $100 Coupon) Delivered @ Roborock via Amazon AU

[Op1616] I ordered Dreame before this coupon was available. Cancelled that order and ordered this.
Saw somewhere that someone was able to get credit back thru their chat. Might be worth exploring.
[frosta85] Just tried chat and got a $100 gift card added to my account ＼(＾O＾)／
[abhiz] Asked me to send back and re-order. Bad luck.
[frosta85] @abhiz: The first rep said the same to me, but I asked to escalate it and the second rep applied the gift card.
[abhiz] @frosta85: Yep, tried that but was adamant. I said, AusPost cost will be more than this $100
[hotdog85] @abhiz: I tried as well but the rep said he literally can't do it on his end
[vinschki] @frosta85: Can you please share a screenshot of the chat/credit?
Edit: talking with them now and being told it’s not possible and I mentioned a “friend” was able to get it credited
[tm001] @vinschki: "escalate" is the keyword.
The "ordinary" agent cannot do it, max $30 credit.
Once they "escalate" no problem to get the $100 credit.
[vinschki] @tm001: I got stonewalled after the escalation too
Edit: claimed there is no process to provide a credit like this.
[Partyboyz] @tm001: Escalated to a supervisor, after a few back and forth they just ended my chat. :(
[Kathiepink] @Partyboyz: Same here! I contacted Amazon customer service several times regarding this issue, but none of the agents were able to provide the $100 price adjustment.
[CatmanAintDead] support said once its arrived, I can write to them again and they will give me $100 credit. Not sure why I have to wait for it to arrive though
[tm001] @CatmanAintDead: I had the same (unrelated product), saved the screenshots of the chat as I was worried the agent just want to get rid of me and pass the issue to someone else.
But no issues at all. Once it arrived I went to chat and got the credit stright away.
With regards to customer service Amazon is by far the best.
[anoykw] I was able to negotiate with the rep, initially offered 60 then 80, finally at 90.
[jecec] I order yeaterday (thursday) too but was ablento cancel it.
[entropysbane] Wow amazing price. Beats the black Friday sale @$999 for the qrevo curv.
[MeliodasIS] Should i go for this over the l10s ultra gen2 i ordered
Is it worth it for home with no carpets.
[Horacio] Wondering this as well. Actually I have a Lubluelu that cost just $100 on special from Temu, and the suction, LiDAR, app etc work amazingly well, but there is one super annoying thing: the exhaust air leaves the robot sideways, ie parallel to the floor. This means that it blows a huge amount of dust from the floor straight into the air before it gets to be vacuumed up. All the surfaces in the room end up covered in dust really fast. This is a frankly HUGE problem - and I am wondering if all these robot vacuums suffer from the same issue?
[jecec] It says page not available.
Was it an error?
[dreamzz] I had a dreame l10 ultra gen2, i returned it and bought this, its a day and night difference, app is so easy to use also much better vaccum for navigating and mopping overall very happy
[Roe Jogan] can u please tell us a bit more about the navigation, in detail, i might go with L pro as i dont want one with a camera/mic like the edge here even tho i would have preferred it
[Jabob] I was literally about to order this earlier at $899 but wasn't 100% sure.
An extra $100 off is enough for me to pull the trigger.
[clausman] I really wanted edge 2 pro but the edge price is really tempting. Dilemma dilemma
[gogobu] on the same boat here… but I decided to wait for the edge 2 pro.
[jecec] The difference in price tho. Hard for me to justify that.
[Spending2Much] As a bachelor working shift work….tile floors with only carpet in bedrooms, looking for a good value Robovac that mops really well and is pretty much set and forget, ie, self cleans, self emptied etc
Is this my best option?
[wombat81] Edge 2 pro is a better option, but obviously more expensive
[jimbobed] Thoughts on this robo vs dreame x40 ultra..700 for dreame x40 ultra with latitude card on prime sale…undecided.
[Krayzii] AH man i was eyeing this out but bought the dreame L10s Ultra gen 2 that was on sale.
[Roe Jogan] i watched a few videos, this does not really climb 4cm too well, check out that dad channel on youtube, if you want a good climber ur gonna have to go with edge 2 or something like a dreame x50 or l50 ultra. i wish we could use it offline, i just cant risk a camera unit and online, many of these can be hacked without much effort
[Cuddlah] Bought one of these back in March for $1299, now I'm bummed that I didn't wait a bit longer for a better deal but it's a fantastic unit.. no ragrets!
[ChiggenWingz] Damn, glad I waited until the weekend :D
[StranJer] Thanks. As my budget is lower, checked and chose the Roborock Qrevo L, around $426 (mobile app). My first robo cleaner. Hoping we will become friends :)
[reservin] been eyeing between Ecovacs T80 or X11 or this and finally pulled trigger since $100 coupon. Thanks
[Idontknowwhy] Atl was this https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/955467 , ~$659 if you returned the f25. Though this did seem like price error
[tm001] Looks like most people got their orders canceled from that deal…
[Planes are cool] thanks, finally bought my first robo vac, getting new flooring next month so we wanna keep them nice and clean, and this should work great
